content:
lee-platform: Heads-up: CrossDock (dedicated) seeing 5-10% request failures p50->p99 increase over last 20m. Customer on high-commitment plan, SLA risk if persists.

tara-cs: Noted. Customer reported during lunch in EU. They said embedding requests spike when batch size > 8.

sara-product: @lee-platform can you confirm which model variant they're pinned to? Also need ETA for mitigation.

lee-platform: They're pinned to rdx-large-v2-quant (pool id: ded-crossdock-3). I suspect autoscaler oscillation + evictions. Logs attached below.

mike-eng: Quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:23Z ded-crossdock-3 node-7 OOM eviction model_worker pid=4221
2026-03-18T14:12:24Z ded-crossdock-3 node-8 request timeout 30s route=/v1/generate
```

nate-oncall: I can do a short-term cap on batch size and force a safer kernel on that pool. Can we do a config change now? @deploy-bot please prepare a rollbackable change.

deploy-bot: build 4f3d7 -> staged; plan: set pool annotation `max_batch_tokens: 4096` and `prefer_stable_kernels: true`. Requires owners ack.

lee-platform: Ack from me. mike-eng you comfortable with kernel toggle? Risk: 5-10% throughput drop but should stop evictions.

mike-eng: Agree. Do it. I'll monitor KV cache pressure and push a quick patch to reduce prefetch threads: `--prefetch=2`.

tara-cs: I'll tell CrossDock support to expect ~5-10% slower but more stable. Need timeline to share.

sara-product: Can we commit to a customer-facing ETA? If deploy now, how long to stabilize and confirm SLA safe?

nate-oncall: Deploy + warmup ~ 12-15 mins. Then run a 30m observation window before telling CS to clear the escalation. So ETA ~ 1hr.

lee-platform: Owners: @mike-eng (kernel + prefetch change), @nate-oncall (deploy + monitor), @tara-cs (customer comms). Dependencies: infra autoscaler tuning (eng-infra) — pinged oncall.

mike-eng: I'm opening a PR for the `--prefetch` change and link it here in 2m.

mike-eng: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/serving/pull/9284

nate-oncall: Rolling change now.

deploy-bot: deployment started (build 4f3d7) -> ded-crossdock-3

deploy-bot: step 1/3: apply pool annotations

deploy-bot: step 2/3: update runtime flags

deploy-bot: step 3/3: verify healthchecks

nate-oncall: Healthchecks passing, p95 errors back to baseline at 14:32Z. Monitoring for 30m.

tara-cs: Notified CrossDock support: "we're rolling a stabilizing change, expect <1hr to confirm. Will update at 15:05Z" :thumbsup:

lee-platform: Thx. After 30m, if stable let's schedule autoscaler tuning with eng-infra (action item). Also follow-up to evaluate batching suggestions from Optimize team.

sara-product: Good plan. Please post a short postmortem if root cause != autoscaler oscillation.

mike-eng: Will collect traces and KV cache dumps; will drop them in the incident doc.

nate-oncall: Last check-in: 15:02Z health window looks stable. If anyone sees regressions call me immediately.

lee-platform: Closing thread for async updates — if we need to escalate reopen. Thanks team.
